notes.title: Patch notes for Mar. 15 / v.1025
notes.content:
Sorry for the delay in patching - I had to take a little time off but am now back to spring into action when required!

[list]
[*] Fixed puzzle 1 of collages 4 and 5 being unselectable with mouse
[*] Fixed puzzle preview box overlapping clues on puzzle #169
[*] Changed fixed framerate to smooth framerate (capped at 60 fps) in the hope to make the game work on frame-locked Steamdecks
[/list]

notes.title: Patch notes for Feb. 29 / v.1024
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed continuous drawing bug when using system cursor
[*] Expanded the use of slightly thicker lines for larger puzzles for clarity
[*] Corrected Marian's gender in the Almanac
[*] Fixed Steam stat count for achievement #23 "Paragon of Olive Town"
[/list]

notes.title: Update 2 Feb 28 / v. 1.023
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added a check for collage puzzle completion in the rare case of untimely crashes (for real this time)
[*] Disabled Lumen global illumination for Steamdeck users to improve battery life
[/list]

notes.title: Patch notes for Feb. 28 / v.1022
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added more DX11 and DX12 material format support (behind the scenes)
[*] Capped framerate to 60fps
[*] Added initial language setting based on Steam settings (1st time only)
[*] Fixed bug where pressing the hints button while hints were set to "off" would still trigger "hints used" icon
[*] Added a check for collage puzzle completion in the rare case of untimely crashes
[*] Added a feature that ever so slightly thickens grid lines on larger puzzles for visual clarity
[*] Fixed some spelling mistakes (English)
[/list]
